# Kalkan — iOS Call Blocker and Caller ID

## Canonical product summary
Kalkan is an iPhone application for identifying known callers and blocking known unwanted numbers. It prepares on-device datasets for Apple's iOS Call Directory framework. iOS performs incoming-call matching; Kalkan does not listen to calls, inspect call audio, access contacts, or perform real-time voice analysis.

## Current availability (checked 2026-08-17)
- Public App Store version: 1.0.5 (109), released 2026-07-27 in Türkiye time
- Version 1.0.6 (110): submitted to Apple App Review; not yet public
- Platform: iPhone / iOS 17.6 or later
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/tr/app/kalkan-caller-id-block/id6759873828
- Languages: Turkish and English

## Feature boundaries
- General Protection: free exact-number blocking and caller identification. It works independently from Extra Protection.
- Extra Protection: optional Premium layer that expands suspicious number patterns into additional blocking entries.
- Kalkan Premium: yearly auto-renewable subscription offered in Türkiye. Eligible new subscriptions may receive a three-month introductory trial shown by the App Store.
- Caller identification: displays a dataset label when iOS finds a match. A label is not cryptographic identity verification and does not prevent caller-ID spoofing.
- Reporting: users can submit suspicious-number reports. Reports are reviewed and do not enter production datasets automatically.
- Announcements: in-app General and Updates feeds with cached/bundled fallback.
- Protection-data reminders: optional local reminders at 1, 3, 6 or 12 months after a successful manual update. These reminders do not update the App Store binary.
- Focus Setup Assistant: explains Apple Focus configuration for Work, Weekend and Project scenarios; Kalkan does not read or change Focus settings.

## Technical operation
1. General exact-identification and exact-blocking data are downloaded over HTTPS.
2. Data is validated, normalized, deduplicated and compiled into on-device artifacts.
3. General identification, General blocking and optional Extra blocking are merged. Blocking has precedence over identification.
4. Kalkan requests a Call Directory Extension reload.
5. iOS checks incoming numbers against the loaded data. The core loaded protection can work offline.

## Privacy and limitations
- No contacts access.
- No call-history access.
- No call-audio or conversation analysis.
- No guarantee that every new or unlisted unwanted number will be detected.
- Internet is required for fresh data, report submission, announcements and StoreKit refresh; already loaded Call Directory matching can work offline.
